The data and Python codes made available here can be used to produce the global and country-specific carbon footprint(s) of narrower-spectrum penicillin through the disaggregation of the pharmaceutical industry in the ICO-2023 EE-MRIO as described in the article titled: "A Hybrid LCA Framework for Drug-Level Carbon Footprint Assessment Under Data Constraints: Application to Narrower-Spectrum Penicillin". https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.est.6c00661 Rosalie H.
